content.stem: [洗钱和恐怖融资的风险及方法]在美国一家大型银行中,有一名员工领导着一个团队,负责监督该行交易监控方法的治理和有效性.团队应实施哪些策略？(选择两项.)

options.A: 定期及临时与法律团队合作,适当调查和监控传票对象或政府调查对象的交易
options.B: 定期审查客户档案,以确保高风险客户的档案信息是最新的,符合银行内部政策和程序的要求.
options.C: 定期审查向金融犯罪执法网络(FinCEN)提交的可疑活动报告(SAR),以确定是否应撤回其中任何一份报告
options.D: 定期审查交易监测场景及其成效,以确保适当反映反洗钱的各类模式

content.stem_en: In a large U.S. bank, an individual leads a team in charge of overseeing the governance and effectiveness of the bank's transaction monitoring approach. Which strategies should the team implement? (Select Two.)

options_en.A: Periodic and ad hoc cooperation with the legal team to appropriately investigate and monitor the transactions of subjects of subpoenas or government inquiries.
options_en.B: Periodic review of client profiles to ensure that the most up-to-date information is on file for high-risk clients in line with the bank's internal policies and procedures.
options_en.C: Periodic review of suspicious activity reports (SARs) filed with FinCEN to determine whether any should be withdrawn.
options_en.D: Periodic review of transaction monitoring scenarios and their productivity to ensure that appropriate AML typologies are reflected.
